outcome: Compliance with oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: 750 eligible obese pregnant women with a BMI > 30 kg/m2 and a live singleton pregnancy
finding: Women who declined participation in the lifestyle intervention study had characteristics suggesting they might benefit most from the intervention, but there was no difference in pregnancy outcomes between participants and non-participants.
mod_finding: There was no difference in mode of delivery observed between women who participated in a lifestyle intervention study during pregnancy and those who did not.
